title: EPA Section 608 Technician Certification Study Manual
description: Official US EPA guidelines and regulatory compliance requirements for Type I, Type II, Type III, and Universal refrigerant handling, recovery, leak repair, and evacuation.

title: OSHA General Industry Safety and Health Regulations
description: Comprehensive federal workplace safety standards, hazard communication, lockout/tagout (LOTO), electrical hazard mitigation, and personal protective equipment (PPE) guidelines.

title: How to Read Blueprints and Electrical Schematics
description: Practical breakdown of architectural symbols, line types, wiring diagrams, ladder logic, and multi-view orthographic projections for technicians.

title: National Electrical Code (NEC) Handbook Reference
description: Foundational electrical safety code reference, circuit ampacity calculation guidelines, grounding and bonding requirements, and overcurrent protection specifications.

title: American Welding Society (AWS) SENSE Welder Training Reference
description: AWS standards for SMAW (Stick), GMAW (MIG), and GTAW (TIG) processes, joint preparation, weld inspections, and structural metallurgy.

title: Bureau of Indian Standards (IS 732 / IS 3043) & CEA Electrical Safety Regulations
description: Indian Standard IS 732 (Code of practice for electrical wiring installations) and IS 3043 (Code of practice for earthing). Covers 230V single-phase / 415V three-phase 50Hz installations, Central Electricity Authority (CEA) safety measures, protective conduit routing, and earth electrode sizing for commercial and residential buildings in India.

title: National Building Code of India (NBC 2016) & DGFASLI Industrial Safety Standards
description: National Building Code of India 2016 Part 4 (Fire & Life Safety) and Part 8 (Building Services - HVAC, Electrical & Mechanical Installations), integrated with Ministry of Labour DGFASLI guidelines and Factories Act 1948 safety requirements.
